# epico.group

> Hub of the epico group (Riazzino-Lavertezzo, Ticino, Switzerland): three companies that cover the whole life of a boat — upholstery and canvas fabrication (epico.ch SA), yacht sales and service (Epico Yachts Swiss) and subscription-based maintenance of boat covers (epico.care).

## Companies

- [epico.ch SA — marine and automotive upholstery](https://www.epico.ch): made-to-measure boat covers, biminis, canopies, cushions; car, motorcycle and aircraft interiors. Own cutting and sewing workshop in Ticino. Phone +41 91 751 60 53, info@epico.ch.
- [Epico Yachts Swiss — yacht sales and service](https://epicoyachts.swiss): official dealer for Pardo Yachts, Rio Yachts, Airon Marine and Grandezza Boats; new, pre-owned and brokerage across Switzerland; technical service, winter storage and maintenance. Phone +41 91 859 23 23, info@epicoyachts.swiss.
- [epico.care — maintenance by subscription](https://epico.care): annual subscription (Base, Comfort, Premium) for inspection, cleaning and repair of boat covers, with loyalty credit to spend in the workshop.

## Facts

- Legal entity: epico.ch SA, Via Cantonale 99, 6595 Riazzino-Lavertezzo, Canton Ticino, Switzerland.
- Sectors: marine (about 80% of activity) and automotive.
- Service area: all of Switzerland; workshop and harbour on Lake Maggiore (Verbano).
- Languages: Italian, German, French, English.
- Social: instagram.com/epico.ch, facebook.com/epico.ch, instagram.com/epicoyachts, facebook.com/epicoyachts.
